verdict.rationale: Solid's README says its minimal abstractions give direct DOM access, making it easy to use native JS libraries like D3. It compiles templates to real DOM nodes, so a `<div>` is a real div. Community users confirm that refs are just the elements and that they use Solid as a go-to for data viz. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the integration pattern (ref/onMount/onCleanup lifecycle for third-party libraries), and a concrete hands-on example of wiring up a charting library.
